text: dsh-prompt-file-injector 是面向 DSH Web 的提示词文件注入插件，会在插件详情卡片提供配置区。用户可将本地文件按系统提示词、每轮消息或 AGENTS 候选文件名三种方式接入模型上下文，并设置提醒频度、工作区范围和单文件字节上限；不可读、超限或非文本文件会被跳过。适合希望为 DSH 会话添加项目说明或自定义指令的用户，不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-prompt-file-injector adds selected local files to DSH Web model context. Configure each file as a system prompt, repeat it each turn, or add its name to AGENTS candidates. Set reminders, workspace scope, and a file size limit in the plugin card. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 每次对话都参考我指定的项目说明文件。
能不能把工作区里的指令文件加入模型上下文？
I want selected local files included in my DSH prompt for each conversation.
dsh-prompt-file-injector 的功能「按模式注入文件」：可将配置的文件内容放入系统提示词，或在每轮消息中重新读取并追加；文件路径按会话工作目录解析，超过字节上限或不是文本时跳过。通过插件配置区为每条路径选择模式。
dsh-prompt-file-injector 的功能「配置 AGENTS 候选文件」：填写裸文件名后，插件会将其加入 DSH 指令文件候选名单，由内核按工作区指令方式加载；可在插件详情卡片配置。

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · dsh-prompt-file-injector：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-file-injector)

[中文](README.zh.md)

Injects files you choose into the model context of DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

See [design/en/current.md](design/en/current.md) for details.

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-file-injector
```

Installing from GitHub is not supported.
dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Features：Adds a configuration area to this plugin's own card on the dsh sidebar's **Plugins** page, where you list paths and pick how each one reaches the model.

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Features：| Mode | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| System prompt | Injects the file's full text as a fixed system prompt section; it stays present for the whole conversation. |
| Every turn | Puts the file's content back into the conversation on every turn, so it stays close to the current topic and always reflects the latest content. The cost is a steady increase in token usage. |
| AGENTS | Adds the file name to the AGENTS loading system dsh ships with, so it loads in the workspace the same way `AGENTS.md` does. |

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Features：A reminder setting next to the list adds a line near the end of the conversation that points the model back to what was injected into the system prompt: **Off**, **Every turn**, or **Every step**.

Each path can also be limited to one workspace. The AGENTS mode has no such choice and always applies in every workspace, so its picker is disabled.

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Settings：| Parameter | Description | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entries | Paths to inject | array | no |
| entries[].path | A file path, or a file name in the workspace for the AGENTS mode | string | yes |
| entries[].mode | The mode this entry uses: one of `system`, `everyRound`, `agents` | string | yes |
| entries[].workspaceId | Limit this entry to one workspace; omit it to inject in every workspace. The AGENTS mode ignores it and always applies in every workspace | string | no |
| reminder | Remind the model near the end of the conversation about what was injected into the system prompt: `off`, `turn` (once per turn), or `step` (also after each tool call) | string | no |
| everyRoundInMinimal | Keep injecting the Every turn content in minimal mode, where the system prompt is owned by the preset's persona (default false) | boolean | no |
| maxFileBytes | Byte cap for one file; a larger file is skipped. Applies to the System prompt and Every turn modes; the AGENTS mode uses the built-in limit (default 65536, entered as KB in the configuration area) | number | no |

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Settings：A relative path is resolved against the working directory of each conversation; an absolute path is used as it is. A file that cannot be read, exceeds the cap, or is binary (not text) is skipped silently.

To use one path with two modes, add it as two entries.

dsh-prompt-file-injector README · Secondary development：Clone this repository into a dsh workspace package directory, then install and build:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/pgnqukezrdxmhjso/dsh-prompt-file-injector packages/my/dsh-prompt-file-injector
pnpm install
pnpm --filter dsh-prompt-file-injector build
```

---

No runtime invariant companion is published because the plugin owns no independent runtime relation to check.
